## Load script and directories
```{r}

# --- 1. Set Up Directories ---
params <- list(
  plot_dir   = "output_ftir/plots",
  data_dir   = "output_ftir/export_data",
  report_dir = "output_ftir/reports"
)
dirs <- map(params, here)
walk(dirs, dir_create, recurse = TRUE)

# --- 2. Locate Input Files ---
input_dir <- here("ft_ir/carageenan/car_ftir_input")
all_files <- dir_ls(input_dir, regexp = "\\.csv$")
metadata_file <- all_files[str_detect(all_files, "sample_data_limited")]
standard_file <- all_files[str_detect(all_files, "standard_kappa")]
sample_files  <- setdiff(all_files, c(metadata_file, standard_file))

# --- 3. Read Metadata ---
metadata <- read_csv(metadata_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(Sample = ID)
meta_vars <- setdiff(names(metadata), "Sample")

# --- 4. Define Spectrum Reader ---
read_spectrum <- function(path, id = NULL) {
  id <- id %||% tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path))
  read_csv(path, skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename(Wavenumber = 1, Absorbance = 2) %>%
    mutate(Sample = id)
}

# --- 5. Load and Combine All Spectra ---
spectra_long   <- map2_dfr(sample_files, basename(sample_files), ~read_spectrum(.x, tools::file_path_sans_ext(.y)))
standard_long  <- read_spectrum(standard_file, "standard")
all_spectra_long <- bind_rows(spectra_long, standard_long)

# --- 6. Convert to Wide Format (Wavenumbers as Rows) ---
spectra_wide <- all_spectra_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = Absorbance) %>%
  rename(Variable = Wavenumber) %>%
  relocate(Variable)

# --- 7. Reshape Metadata to Long Format ---
metadata_long <- metadata %>%
  mutate(across(-Sample, as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Sample, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  slice(-n()) %>%  # remove last row if needed
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = Value) %>%
  select(Variable, everything())

# --- 8. Convert Spectra to Matrix Format (Samples as Rows) ---
spectral_matrix <- spectra_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(-Variable, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Absorbance") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Variable, values_from = Absorbance)

# --- 9. Convert Metadata to Matrix Format (Samples as Rows) ---
metadata_matrix <- metadata_long %>%
  pivot_longer(-Variable, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Variable, values_from = Value)

# --- 10. Add NA Row for Standard ---
# Ensure all columns match by name and type
if (!"standard" %in% metadata_matrix$Sample) {
  n_meta_cols <- ncol(metadata_matrix)
  meta_col_names <- colnames(metadata_matrix)

  # Create a named list with NA_character_ for all columns except Sample and Group
  empty_values <- rep(NA_character_, n_meta_cols)
  names(empty_values) <- meta_col_names
  empty_values["Sample"] <- "standard"
  empty_values["Group"]  <- "standard"

  standard_row <- as_tibble_row(empty_values)
  metadata_matrix <- bind_rows(metadata_matrix, standard_row)
}


# --- 11. Merge Metadata and Spectra ---
main_input <- metadata_matrix %>%
  relocate(Sample, Group) %>%
  left_join(spectral_matrix, by = "Sample")

# --- 12. Export Output Files ---
write_csv(main_input, file.path(dirs$data_dir, "metaboanalyst_main_input_data.csv"))
write_csv(metadata_matrix, file.path(dirs$data_dir, "metaboanalyst_secondary_metadata.csv"))

message("✅ MetaboAnalyst input and metadata files saved.")
```
